publication_surface.identifier: Official Journal references of harmonised standards supporting Directive 2014/35/EU
publication_surface.authenticity_basis: Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12 makes publication of a harmonised-standard reference in the Official Journal the condition for presumption of conformity with covered safety objectives.

dependencies.condition_statement: Presumption of conformity under Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12 depends on conformity with harmonised standards or parts whose references have been published in the Official Journal.

scope.statement: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1464 formally decides not to publish the OJ reference to EN 60335-2-14:2006 (including the listed amendments/corrections) after concluding that it fails to meet specified safety objectives of Directive 2014/35/EU.

source_refs.locator: Article 1 — decision not to publish the reference to EN 60335-2-14:2006
Article 2 — entry into force on publication in the Official Journal on 18 July 2025

forbidden_inferences: Publication or adoption of EN 60335-2-14:2006 by a standards organisation by itself gives presumption of conformity under Directive 2014/35/EU.
The Commission decision not to publish the OJ reference means the European standard itself ceases to exist.
Lack of OJ-reference presumption means use of the standard is prohibited or that no alternative conformity route exists under Directive 2014/35/EU.
Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1464 is a textual amendment of Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12.
notes: Candidate-B frozen #411 formal-nonpublication case for kitchen machines.
